source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1958, p. 7 ("Four contests in 23 divisions of Antrim County Council; Newtownabbey a new division"); Belfast News-Letter, 5 June 1958, p. 5 ("Local elections: polling to-day")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: 'four of the 23 electoral divisions, among them Newtownabbey, a new division' (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1958, p. 7); Newtownabbey returned two members, the other divisions one each.

note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council on the 23 county electoral divisions; nominations received on 20 May 1958, withdrawals to 21 May, and polling on Thursday 5 June 1958 ('Polling to-day', Belfast News-Letter, 5 June 1958, p. 5; 'results ... held ... yesterday', Irish News, 6 June 1958, p. 1). Four divisions were contested: Newtownabbey (two seats), Ballymena, Islandmagee and Randalstown. Party labels were printed only for the Newtownabbey candidates. Returned unopposed.
